name: Season Pricing
description: Three passes side by side under a season switch, with prices that roll to new figures when the season changes.

props.name: plans
props.description: The passes, shown side by side from 672px and stacked below. Each has an id, a name, an optional description, prices by season id, an optional per line under the price, features, the action label and recommended. Rows line up across the passes: names, prices, lists and actions.

props.name: plans[].recommended
props.description: Marks the pass with a water-blue top edge and a short tag; a string replaces the tag text. The pass keeps the same size as the others and its action becomes the water button.

props.name: seasons
props.type: { id: string; label: string; dates?: string }[]
props.description: The options in the season switch. The dates of the selected season are shown under it and announced when they change.

props.name: title
props.description: A heading at the top left, set in the display face.

props.name: onValueChange
props.description: Called with the season id when the switch changes. Each digit of each price rolls to its new figure, up when prices rise and down when they fall.

props.name: onChoose
props.description: Called when a pass's action is pressed.

props.name: currency
props.description: ISO currency code for the prices.

props.name: locale
props.description: Locale used to format the prices.

props.name: children
props.description: Small print under the passes, such as dates and conditions.

props.name: className
props.description: Classes for the section. Other section props are passed through.
